name: mime.quotedprintable
doc:
Quoted-printable (RFC 2045 section 6.7), as Go's mime/quotedprintable:
lines of at most 76 characters with soft breaks ("=\r\n"), "=XX" for
'=' and non-printable bytes, trailing white space encoded, hard line
breaks as \r\n (or encoded too in binary mode).

items.name: Decode
items.doc:
Decodes quoted-printable text: soft breaks are removed, white space at
the end of encoded lines is dropped, line breaks are kept as written,
and (as Go) a '=' not followed by two hex digits is kept literally.
items.summary: Decodes quoted-printable text: soft breaks are removed, white space at the end of encoded lines is dropped, line breaks are kept as written, and (as Go) a '=' not followed by two hex digits is kept literally.

items.name: Encode
items.doc: Encodes text data (its line breaks stay line breaks, written as \r\n).
items.summary: Encodes text data (its line breaks stay line breaks, written as \r\n).

items.name: EncodeBinary
items.doc: Encodes binary data: \r and \n are encoded like other bytes.
items.summary: Encodes binary data: \r and \n are encoded like other bytes.
